limitations: Only nonnegative Hilbert–Schmidt-normalized 3-cycle weights, Schatten exponent six and 0<=t<=1. Full text of the initiating 2026 paper was inaccessible; equivalent earlier matrix-moment optimizations remain a priority risk.
scientific_integrity: Finite exact arithmetic supports, but does not replace, the analytic trace expansion and sharp Schur-inequality proof. Novelty is a self-review, not an independent certification.
title: A sharp sixth-Schatten support transition for weighted three-cycles
